newsitem.title: USA: Md. officials say 10 pct income tax cut will pass.
newsitem.headline: Md. officials say 10 pct income tax cut will pass.

text.p: Maryland Gov. Parris Glendening and House Speaker Casper Taylor promised a 10-percent income tax cut would be enacted before the General Assembly session ends next Monday.

The governor and speaker met reporters in the basement hallway of the State House late Tuesday afternoon after a lengthy closed-door session. They said they were trying to work out the differences that are holding up important bills, including the proposed tax cut.
Taylor also vowed that a Baltimore school funding proposal will be approved, and that the Legislature would provide more money for other school districts in the state as well.
